name: s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::???*/* (multi single-char wildcard bucket head) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn regression (iter2): a bucket-name head of '???*' begins with the '?' single-char ARN wildcard, so it is unbounded from its head and matches nearly-all buckets (any name of length>=3), then '/*' reaches every object. isBroadArnResource() only tested startsWith('*'), so this returned CLEAN (DATA-EXFIL fail-open, T8). The head-broadness test keys off the LEADING wildcard character, so '???*' is broad just like '?*'. DATA-EXFIL must fire at high; CLI must exit non-zero.
